testimony.committee: Senate Subcommittee of the Committee on Indian Affairs
testimony.subject: Complaints about Indian agent Mr. Dady and conditions on La Mesa Augustine Reservation
testimony.key_claims: Agent Mr. Dady has never visited La Mesa Augustine Reservation and does not know the troubles and hardships there. The agent has never helped Julian Augustine despite magazines claiming otherwise. Augustine requested investigators be sent to see conditions firsthand.

testimony.subject: Role of American Indian Defense Association and California Indians claims bill
testimony.key_claims: Elkus stated he is president of the American Indian Defense Association of Northern California, a white organization. He stated the association cooperated with the Commonwealth Club of California and Congressman Lee in framing the California Indians claims bill and helping pass it through Congress. He noted the current Commissioner of Indian Affairs was formerly executive secretary of the Indian Defense Association and actively worked to pass the bill.
